title: Surreal Cosmic Throne
description: A purple-skinned queen with a golden crown and long flowing hair sits on a large purple geometric platform, holding a sad yellow theatrical mask with horns. Below her, a crowd of silhouetted figures reach upward with glowing yellow hands. The background features a swirling cosmic vortex with planets, a black hole eclipse, a distant castle on a hill, barren trees, and a woman in a green patterned headscarf standing in mist.
prompt: A mystical purple-skinned queen wearing a golden crown sits on a floating purple geometric platform in a surreal dreamscape, holding a sad yellow demon mask with horns. Below her, a crowd of green silhouettes desperately reach up with glowing hands. A swirling galaxy vortex with planets, stars, and a black hole eclipse fills the sky above a distant castle on a hill, barren trees, and a woman in a green headscarf standing in mist, dramatic sunset lighting, intricate fantasy illustration.
